title.zh: Ten days later, Git on macOS still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
title.en: Ten days later, Git on macOS still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates

current_state.zh: Ten days after eMudhra certificates were compromised, macOS still trusts them at the system level, leaving Git and other OS-supplied utilities vulnerable to interception unless users manually patch the trust store.
current_state.en: Ten days after eMudhra certificates were compromised, macOS still trusts them at the system level, leaving Git and other OS-supplied utilities vulnerable to interception unless users manually patch the trust store.
